title: One Fish Two Fish
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at “One Fish Two Fish”, a luxury 8-bed, 8.5-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 26 guests, this home offers a Private Pool, Lake Access, Elevator & Golf Cart for your enjoyment. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: • Lakefront with Gulf Views • Private Dock and Access to Big Redfish Lake • Heated Pool overlooking the lake (Pool can be heated for an additional $70 per day from October 1 - May 1) • 3 Stories & 6,400 Square Feet • 6 Seater Golf Cart & 6 Adult Bikes Included • Elevator • Short walk to the beach • Parking for 6 Vehicles Escape to One Fish Two Fish, a stunning waterfront retreat on Big Redfish Lake, just a block from the sugar-white sands of 30A. With deeded beach access and the rare opportunity to paddle directly from your private dock to the Gulf, this extraordinary vacation rental offers the perfect combination of coastal elegance and lakeside serenity. Designed to accommodate up to 24 guests, this luxurious property spans over 6,400 square feet of meticulously crafted living space, with an additional 1,700 square feet of covered outdoor areas for relaxation and entertainment. From the moment you arrive, you’ll be captivated by the sweeping views of Big Redfish Lake and glimpses of the Gulf. Outdoor living takes center stage at One Fish Two Fish, with an oversized private pool, expansive porches, and a fully equipped summer kitchen overlooking the lake. Spend your days swimming, kayaking, or paddleboarding from the private dock, or unwind with a drink in hand as you watch the sunset over the serene waters. Inside, the home is a masterpiece of coastal luxury, featuring eight spacious bedrooms, each with an en-suite bathroom for ultimate comfort and privacy. The interiors showcase a soothing palette of soft, neutral tones and high-end furnishings that embody the essence of a refined beach retreat. The main living areas are designed for effortless entertaining, with a chef’s kitchen boasting dual marble-clad islands, a Wolf range, Sub-Zero appliances, and ample space for family and friends to gather. The adjacent great room, with its soaring 12-foot ceilings and elegant fireplace, opens onto expansive balconies that offer breathtaking views of the lake and surrounding native pines. For added convenience, the home features multiple entertainment spaces, including a first-level great room with a wet bar and a third-floor lounge with treetop views. Modern amenities, such as TVs throughout, multi-zone Sonos surround sound, and security cameras, ensure a seamless and enjoyable stay. Located in the heart of Blue Mountain Beach, One Fish Two Fish is just moments away from popular local restaurants like Redfish Taco and Local Catch, as well as boutique shopping and entertainment at Gulf Place. With ample parking and easy access to multiple beach entry points, this property is perfect for creating unforgettable memories with family and friends. Whether you’re seeking a peaceful lakeside escape or an activity-filled beach getaway, One Fish Two Fish promises an unparalleled vacation experience. Book your stay today and let the magic of 30A welcome you home.
